title: Novel Direction: Evaluating AI-Assisted Security for AI-Generated Code Specifically

original_idea.body:
# Novel Direction: Evaluating AI-Assisted Security for AI-Generated Code Specifically

**Problem:** AI-generated code has specific vulnerability patterns (Veracode: 45% vulnerable). AI security tools may perform differently on AI-generated vs. human-written code.

**Direction:** Generate 25 code samples using Copilot/Claude Code for the same functionality. For each, also get a human-written version from open-source. Run AI vulnerability scanners on both versions. Compare: detection rate, false positive rate, vulnerability class distribution. Test whether AI-generated code has different scanner performance.

**Why it matters:** If AI security tools are trained on human-written code, they may be poorly calibrated for AI-generated code, precisely where new vulnerabilities are being introduced fastest.

**Relevant context:** Veracode 2025: AI introduces vulnerabilities 45% of the time. AI security scanning calibration for AI-generated code is not studied. This is a novel and increasingly important deployment scenario.
